scripts.api:generate: bun run --cwd backend openapi && bun run --cwd frontend api:generate
scripts.api:check: bun run api:generate && git diff --exit-code -- backend/openapi.json frontend/src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd backend typecheck && bun run --cwd frontend typecheck && bun x tsc --project computer-controller/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run --cwd backend db:generate && bun backend/scripts/test.ts
